sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-setup.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
DATA_IMG=/var/lib/snapstore/data.img
COW_IMG=/var/lib/snapstore/cow.img

# (re)attach loop devices idempotently
LOOP_DATA=$(losetup -j "$DATA_IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOP_DATA" ]; then
  LOOP_DATA=$(losetup -f --show "$DATA_IMG")
fi
LOOP_COW=$(losetup -j "$COW_IMG" | cut -d: -f1)
if [ -z "$LOOP_COW" ]; then
  LOOP_COW=$(losetup -f --show "$COW_IMG")
fi

if ! dmsetup info data-origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  SZ=$(blockdev --getsz "$LOOP_DATA")
  dmsetup create data-origin --table "0 $SZ snapshot-origin $LOOP_DATA"
fi

mkdir -p /srv/data
if ! mountpoint -q /srv/data; then
  mount /dev/mapper/data-origin /srv/data
fi
EOF
sudo -n chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-setup.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-setup.sh
